Subtitle text 'Black: true (unshifted, cleaned) power. Orange: forecast made from the shifted history, with its 5% to 95% band. Purple dashed: median forecast of the same weights from the unshifted history. One Primary, one origin (day 12 of January 2026), seed 0, shift lasting 15 days.'
text.tspan: Black: true (unshifted, cleaned) power. Orange: forecast made from the shifted history, with its 5% to 95% band.
Purple dashed: median forecast of the same weights from the unshifted history. One Primary, one origin (day 12 of January 2026), seed 0, shift lasting 15 days.
